clue.text: Florence's dark singers

parts.note: reads as a famous nurse's family, but it means songbirds that sing after dark

explanation.walkthrough: Florence Nightingale, the Victorian nursing pioneer, lends her surname; the birds of that name are famous for singing at night.
explanation.definitionFit: These songbirds are celebrated for their nocturnal song, so they are singers of the dark hours.

clue.text: Send up cage with air for space traveller

indicators.note: in a down clue, sending a word up means reading the word for cage from bottom to top

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure or cage
an air is a tune or melody

explanation.surface: Someone launches a cage full of air as a vessel for a space traveller.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'Send up' reads the cage word bottom to top; the space traveller is a planet, not an astronaut.
explanation.definitionFit: A planet travels through space on its orbit, so the eighth planet is a traveller in space.

clue.text: Calculate yardstick

definitions.meaning: to estimate or measure an amount

explanation.definitionFit: To estimate is to measure an amount, and a measuring standard or instrument is a yardstick.

clue.text: Dress collection for use as tour moves round

indicators.note: the letters of the words use as tour are moved round into a new order

explanation.surface: A traveller's outfits are reused because the tour keeps moving from place to place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moves round' rearranges USEASTOUR.
explanation.definitionFit: A bride's collection of clothes and linen for married life is her trousseau.

clue.text: Informer to name boat

parts.note: an ark is a boat, as in Noah's

explanation.surface: A police informer is asked to give a boat a name.
explanation.walkthrough: NARK is British slang for a police informer.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang a police spy or informant is a nark.

clue.text: Nevertheless health ought to include it

indicators.note: the words health ought are said to include the answer within their run of letters

explanation.surface: Someone says that, nevertheless, a health regime ought to include it.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across heALTH OUGHt.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words concede a point while going on regardless, synonyms in a sentence like 'nevertheless, he came'.

clue.text: Don't start to apologise — this may be a feather in your hat!

definitions.text: this may be a feather in your hat

indicators.note: tells us to leave off the opening letter of the word meaning apologise

parts.note: to regret something is to express sorrow or apology for it

explanation.surface: A cheeky retort: no need to start apologising, it may be a feather in your cap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Don't start' drops R from REGRET. The surface echoes 'a feather in your cap', an achievement.
explanation.definitionFit: The plumes of this white heron were once prized for decorating hats.

clue.text: Aircraft with a sting in the nose

definitions.meaning: the de Havilland wooden fighter-bomber of the Second World War

definitions.text: with a sting in the nose
definitions.meaning: describes a biting insect whose piercing mouthpart is at the front of its head

explanation.surface: A warplane armed with weapons in its nose.
explanation.definitionFit: A famous RAF warplane shares its name with the biting insect that pierces skin with its proboscis.

clue.text: About to state the name of Clementine's dwelling

parts.note: C, short for circa, means about
to aver is to state or assert
N is the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: Someone is about to give the name of where Clementine lives.
explanation.walkthrough: The American folk song 'Oh My Darling, Clementine' begins 'In a cavern, in a canyon', where she lived with her miner father.
explanation.definitionFit: The song places the miner's daughter living in an underground hollow, so that hollow is her home.

clue.text: One like Midas, in the cart, undone by a god

indicators.note: by means beside, so the god sits next to the rearranged word

parts.note: Pluto is the Roman god of the underworld and of wealth

indicators.note: the word cart is undone and put together again in a different order

explanation.surface: A rich king rides in a cart that a god overturns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'undone' turns CART into CRAT, placed beside PLUTO.
explanation.definitionFit: King Midas, whose touch turned things to gold, is the type of the immensely wealthy ruler.

clue.text: Sound haunted a girl

indicators.note: tells us the answer is said the same way as the following words when spoken

parts.note: haunted gives rode, as a nightmare rode or haunted a sleeper, followed by a

explanation.surface: A noise frightened a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' signals that RODE A, said out loud, matches the girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a female first name, so it stands for a girl in crossword fashion.

clue.text: State of the King's head after coronation

definitions.text: State of the King's head after coronation

parts.words: State of the King's head after coronation
parts.note: alludes to Shakespeare's line about the head that wears a crown lying ill at ease

explanation.walkthrough: In Henry IV Part 2 the king says 'Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown'.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's troubled king says a crowned head lies restless and anxious.

clue.text: Bouquet one ordered from a shop

indicators.note: the letters of bouquet plus the numeral are ordered afresh

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A bunch of flowers is ordered from a florist's shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' rearranges BOUQUETI.
explanation.definitionFit: A small fashionable store selling clothes or gifts is a boutique.

clue.text: Answer back after opponents get prize

indicators.note: after places the turned word after the bridge players

parts.note: E and S are opposing partnerships at the bridge table, East and South

indicators.note: the word meaning answer is turned back to front

parts.note: to meet a need or demand is to answer it

explanation.surface: A competitor responds after rivals win the trophy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opponents' are bridge partnerships East and South; 'back' turns the answer word round. Prize here is the verb, to value, not a trophy.
explanation.definitionFit: To prize someone is to value them highly, to hold them in high regard.

clue.text: In a state of confusion, it's plain

indicators.note: being in a state suggests disorder, so the letters of it's plain are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone flustered declares that the matter is obvious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a state of' rearranges ITSPLAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A falling aircraft's spin gives the figurative sense of a panicky loss of control or chaos.

clue.text: Key to blast-off?

parts.note: reads as the vital factor for a rocket launch, but also as the car key that starts an engine

explanation.walkthrough: The key that starts a car engine is named after the firing of fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: Firing of fuel starts a rocket launch, and the car key that starts the engine bears that name.

clue.text: Taormina — a resort for one in love

indicators.note: read as re-sort, the letters of Taormina a are sorted again

explanation.surface: The Sicilian town of Taormina is a resort for lovers.
explanation.walkthrough: Taormina really is a Sicilian resort, so 're-sort' hides in plain sight; rearrange TAORMINAA.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian-derived word for a female lover or sweetheart.

clue.text: Started to fish in retirement

indicators.note: the fish goes in the word for retirement

parts.note: retiring for the night means going to bed
the roach is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A pensioner began fishing once retired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retirement' misleads towards pensions; here it means going to bed for the night.
explanation.definitionFit: To broach a subject is to raise or begin it, so broached means opened up or begun.

clue.text: Final notice — you're almost a bit upset

indicators.note: the remaining letters with a bit are upset into a fresh order
almost means the word you're loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A last warning letter has you somewhat distressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims YOURE to YOUR; 'upset' rearranges YOURABIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A death notice in a newspaper is the last public announcement about someone.

clue.text: Mysterious leader at head of sect

indicators.note: places the leader at the start of the word for sect

parts.note: OC is Officer Commanding, a military leader
a cult is a religious sect

explanation.surface: An enigmatic figure leads a religious sect.
explanation.walkthrough: OC (Officer Commanding) goes 'at head of' CULT.
explanation.definitionFit: Occult knowledge is secret or supernatural, beyond ordinary understanding.

clue.text: Dismiss to settle the score

definitions.meaning: to ... workers is to give them final wages and let them go

explanation.definitionFit: Paying off staff means discharging them, and a final reckoning or revenge is also called by this phrase.

clue.text: Furniture for the great say

parts.note: great said aloud is grate, so this is a fittings item for a fireplace

explanation.walkthrough: 'great, say' points to 'grate': an andiron is a metal support for logs in a fireplace.
explanation.definitionFit: An andiron, a metal stand holding logs in a hearth, is fireplace equipment.

clue.text: Sound reason for abandoning "Robinson Crusoe'"?

parts.note: suggests a good motive, but describes the marooned sailor himself, thrown away by the sea

explanation.walkthrough: Defoe's hero is the classic shipwrecked survivor; the phrase also means thrown aside.
explanation.definitionFit: Defoe's hero is a shipwrecked sailor stranded on an island, the archetypal marooned man.

clue.text: Park-keeper loses head in temper

indicators.note: the word for park-keeper loses its first letter

parts.note: a ranger looks after a park or forest

explanation.surface: A park warden loses his cool and flies into a rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses head' drops R from RANGER.
explanation.definitionFit: Temper in the sense of a fit of rage is fury or wrath.

clue.text: Beauty in the wine trade

definitions.meaning: someone who stops bottles with corks

explanation.definitionFit: A stunner is something excellent, and a bottle-stopping worker in a winery fits the second sense.

clue.text: One of the regimental colours

parts.note: colours suggests a regiment's flag, but it is the dull shade of army uniform

explanation.walkthrough: A regiment's 'colours' are its flags, but here the word means a shade of uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: The dull brownish-yellow of army uniforms is a military shade.

clue.text: Recognize a billiards player

definitions.meaning: in billiards the white ball with a dot, and its player, are named this, opposite 'plain'

explanation.definitionFit: To pick out is to notice, and in billiards the marked white ball, and the player using it, take this name.

clue.text: Not standing for perjury

explanation.definitionFit: Being prone is the opposite of standing, and perjury is telling untruths under oath.

clue.text: Out of luck venture is slipshod

parts.note: hap is an old word for luck or chance
to hazard is to venture or risk

explanation.surface: A gambler who has run out of luck becomes careless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out of' just links: the answer is made out of the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in a careless, random way without plan, so sloppy.

clue.text: Acclaim serviceman for reliability test

parts.note: credit is praise or acclaim
a rating is a sailor in the Royal Navy below officer rank

explanation.surface: Praise a soldier who passed a test of dependability.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'rating' is an ordinary sailor in the Royal Navy.
explanation.definitionFit: Lenders assess a borrower's trustworthiness to repay before granting loans.
